# Be Fit After 60

> Functional fitness classes and personal training for adults over 60, in person in Fairfield, Iowa and live on Zoom. Taught by Joe Weaver, age 75, a trained Active Aging Specialist.

## Key facts
- Location: 200 S. Main St., Fairfield, Iowa 52556
- Phone: 828-964-6622 (call or text) · Email: joe@befitafter60.com
- Fairfield classes: Mondays and Thursdays at 10:20, 11:00 and 11:40 a.m. Central; 35 minutes; $15.50 per class ($13.90 per person for couples); billed monthly for classes attended; first 2 weeks free
- Zoom General Fitness: Mon/Wed/Fri 8:45 a.m. Central; 45 minutes; $140 per month; strength, balance, endurance, flexibility and mobility
- Zoom Stronger After 60: Tue/Fri 7:45 a.m. Central; 45 minutes; $160 per month; strength-focused with a 5-minute flexibility warm-up
- Zoom free trial: 3 weeks for new or returning clients
- Personal training: $50 per 35-minute session, in Fairfield or on Zoom
- Approach: safety first, fun second, results third; resistance bands and bodyweight instead of free weights; breathing technique; music from the 1950s–70s
- Suitable for beginners and people with conditions such as MS, diabetes, joint replacements and knee problems
